clips.title: The story
paras: In the Valley of Trials, a marked parchment sends you to Frang after you prove yourself against local beasts. The warrior trainer waits outside the Den.

After you prove you can face the Mottled Boars, Gornek hands you a parchment marked specifically for you. Durotar is harsh, and the Horde quickly gives its fighters guidance. The parchment directs you to Frang, the veteran warrior trainer outside the Den.

Frang shelters in the shade outside the Den and watches recruits arrive from the red scrubland. With a seasoned eye, he judges each new arrival before teaching the fundamentals, whether with a heavy axe or a spear. He prepares each recruit to defend the young Horde's fragile settlements.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, friend.
Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the warrior trainer Frang. He would have words with you when you're ready. You'll find him outside the Den, taking cover in the shade.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Another traveler to bolster the ranks. Good enough for me.
You'll probably have a hard time hefting a good weapon like an axe, but a spear's just as good as anything else.
Welcome to the Valley of Trials.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You'll find this place fitting as you continue to train in the adventurer ways. If you have any questions, feel free to ask anyone around, and when you feel you're ready, come back to me for training. I've mastered as much as any adventurer here in the Valley and can pass that knowledge on to you... For a price.
